description: A hormonal disorder common among women of reproductive age where the ovaries produce an abnormal amount of androgens. PCOS affects 1 in 10 women of childbearing age.

diagnostic_criteria.rotterdam_criteria: Diagnosis requires 2 of 3: irregular periods, excess androgens (clinical or lab), polycystic ovaries on ultrasound

lifestyle_first_line.weight_loss: Even 5-10% weight loss can restore ovulation and significantly improve symptoms
exercise: HIIT shown effective for insulin resistance
stress: Chronic stress worsens cortisol and androgen levels

menstrual_regulation: Combined oral contraceptives (regulate cycle, reduce androgens)
insulin_resistance: Metformin — reduces insulin resistance, can restore ovulation, supports weight loss

evidence_based: Inositol (myo-inositol + D-chiro-inositol 40:1 ratio) — improves insulin sensitivity and ovulation
Vitamin D — commonly deficient in PCOS, supports insulin sensitivity
Omega-3 fatty acids — reduces inflammation and androgens

monitoring: Endometrial thickness if periods absent >3 months
when_to_see_doctor: Always seek evaluation for PCOS — it is a complex hormonal disorder requiring proper diagnosis and management plan
